description: This file contains unit tests for the PersonByNameComparator class, verifying comparison logic between Person objects based on their names.

classes.name: PersonByNameComparatorTest
classes.description: Test class for PersonByNameComparator methods, containing various test cases to verify comparison logic.

methods.name: comparePersonsByName_shouldReturnNegativeIfPersonNameForPerson1ComesBeforeThatOfPerson2
methods.description: Tests that the comparator returns a negative value when Person1's name should come before Person2's name.

methods.name: comparePersonsByName_shouldReturnPositiveIfPersonNameForPerson1ComesAfterThatOfPerson2
methods.description: Tests that the comparator returns a positive value when Person1's name should come after Person2's name.

methods.name: comparePersonsByName_shouldReturnZeroIfTheGivenNameMiddleNameAndFamilyNameMatch
methods.description: Verifies that the comparator returns zero when both Person objects have identical names.

methods.name: comparePersonsByName_shouldNotBeCaseSensitive
methods.description: Checks that the comparison is case-insensitive.
